rows.text: [Trailblazer], you remember that sidekick? It left after its mission was accomplished.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Still, it spent all the credits in its account to post a "Collaborator Recruitment" advert on the Interastral Network for the Simulated Universe. It said although it couldn't disclose the exact details of the job, it can honor the bet in a different way.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I'm surprised by how developed the... "free will" of a robot is nowadays.
rows.speaker: Herta
